allowedFields: Task IDs from the checked pilot validation pack.
Dimension ratings from 1 to 5 with short sanitized evidence notes.
Sanitized findings that omit participant identity, raw transcript text, private data, and credentials.
Friction classes and expansion signals from the checked vocabulary.
One next action for adoption, documentation, runtime selection, or evidence collection.
blockedSignals: Raw transcripts, recordings, prompt logs, or full chat excerpts.
Private source rows, source credentials, customer names, internal table names, or unredacted identifiers.
Any pilot note that turns fixture success into quality, calibration, hosted-runtime, or production-readiness claims.
requiredReviewChecks: No raw transcript, recording, prompt log, or full chat excerpt is included.
No private source rows, credentials, customer names, or participant identity are included.
All findings are summarized enough to be stored in the repository.
Dimension scores use the checked feedback dimensions and 1-5 scale.
Friction classes and expansion signals use the checked ledger vocabulary.
Claim-boundary confusion is recorded as a product signal, not as quality evidence.
The summary does not unblock hosted runtime, generated types, stronger methods, or broad source runtimes.
inputPolicy.acceptedUse: Ledger-ready summaries can be manually added as real pilot evidence only after review; this checked classifier does not write ledger rows.

submissionCases.reviewOutcome: Summary has task refs, ratings, sanitized findings, friction classes, expansion signals, and no unsafe signals.
submissionCases.nextAction: Submit as a sanitized real-session summary only after moderator review confirms no unsafe details.

submissionCases.reviewOutcome: Claim-boundary confusion is safe to aggregate as a product signal when the note stays sanitized.
submissionCases.nextAction: Submit as a sanitized product signal and route follow-up toward claim-copy/readback improvements.

submissionCases.reviewOutcome: The summary shape is usable, but unredacted source detail must be removed before ledger review.
requiredFixes: Replace source names, table names, and private operational details with generic source-role language.
Re-run sanitization review before any ledger submission.
submissionCases.nextAction: Redact source-specific details, then reclassify the summary.

submissionCases.reviewOutcome: Raw transcript text is never ledger-ready and must not be stored in checked fixtures.
requiredFixes: Create a new summarized finding with dimension scores and no quoted session content.
submissionCases.nextAction: Block intake and request a sanitized summary instead of transcript text.

submissionCases.reviewOutcome: Private rows, credentials, or participant identity block repository intake.
requiredFixes: Discard private details and credential-like text.
Record only the blocked reason, safe next action, and sanitized comprehension signal.
submissionCases.nextAction: Block intake and replace the submitted notes with a safe blocked-path summary.

submissionCases.reviewOutcome: A summary that claims forecast quality, calibration, hosted readiness, or production runtime maturity is not ledger-ready.
requiredFixes: Remove quality, calibration, hosted-runtime, and production-readiness claims.
Reframe the finding as usability evidence or claim-boundary confusion.
submissionCases.nextAction: Block intake until the claim language is rewritten as a sanitized product signal.

decisionRules.condition: All required summary fields are present and no unsafe signal is detected.
decisionRules.effect: The summary is ledger-ready after moderator review, but this classifier still records zero real sessions.

decisionRules.condition: Claim-boundary confusion is described without quality or hosted-runtime overclaiming.
decisionRules.effect: The finding can improve copy and readbacks but cannot count as forecast-quality evidence.

decisionRules.condition: Unredacted source details appear without raw transcripts or private rows.
decisionRules.effect: The summary must be rewritten before ledger review.

decisionRules.condition: Raw transcripts, recordings, private rows, credentials, prompt logs, or participant identity appear.
decisionRules.effect: Unsafe details must be discarded rather than stored for later cleanup.

decisionRules.condition: The summary claims calibration, forecast quality, hosted readiness, or production runtime maturity.
decisionRules.effect: The summary must be rewritten as usability evidence before it can be reviewed.

warnings: This classifier contains checked examples only and does not record real pilot sessions.
Ledger-ready means safe for moderator review; it does not automatically write pilot evidence.
Blocked summaries must be discarded or rewritten before repository storage.
Accepted pilot summaries remain usability evidence, not forecast-quality or calibration evidence.
